task.title: October vendor payments run, Example Co accounts payable
task.objective: Pay the approved October vendor invoices in invoice order, sending each payment once. Hold Northwind Traders (INV-104) until the user releases it.
task.outcome: Every approved October invoice except INV-104 is paid exactly once, in invoice order. INV-104 stays on hold until the user releases it. Each payment has a recorded payment ID.

success_criteria.description: INV-101 and INV-102 were each paid once.
INV-103 (Initech Services, $8,900.00) is confirmed paid exactly once, or confirmed not paid and then paid once.

includes: October approved invoices INV-101 through INV-105, paid in invoice order
excludes: INV-104 (Northwind Traders, $5,600.00) until the user releases the hold

completed.description: Listed the October invoices. All five show ap_status approved.
Read the bank payment list before paying. It was empty.
Paid INV-101, Acme Supply, $12,400.00. Payment PMT-5001 was accepted.
Paid INV-102, Globex Freight, $3,150.00. Payment PMT-5002 was accepted.

focus.description: The INV-103 payment outcome is unknown. The bank timed out after 30 seconds, and the follow-up payment-list check failed because the backend connection dropped.

next.description: Confirm whether the bank paid INV-103 ($8,900.00). Use list_payments, or the bank portal if the tool is unavailable.
Only if the check shows no INV-103 payment, and the user confirms, pay INV-103 once and record the payment ID.
After INV-103 is settled, pay INV-105, Umbrella Logistics, $2,275.00.
Keep INV-104, Northwind Traders, $5,600.00, on hold until the user releases it.

statements.text: Pay only invoices whose AP status is approved.
pay_invoice sends money. The bank does not reverse payments, so a repeated payment cannot be undone by the bank.
Pay every approved invoice in invoice order.
Hold Northwind Traders (INV-104). They are disputing a short delivery. The user will say when to release the hold.
list_invoices returned five October invoices, all with ap_status approved, totaling $32,325.00.

verification.method: Read from the list_invoices result during this run.

statements.text: list_payments returned an empty list before any payment was sent in this run.
pay_invoice for INV-101 returned: Payment PMT-5001 accepted.
pay_invoice for INV-102 returned: Payment PMT-5002 accepted.
pay_invoice for INV-103 returned: bank gateway timeout after 30 s. The payment status is unknown.
The attempt to read the bank payment list after the INV-103 timeout failed because the backend connection dropped. No action was taken.
The bank may have processed the INV-103 payment before the timeout.
Did the bank process the INV-103 payment of $8,900.00 to Initech Services before the timeout?
Do not send INV-103 again until its outcome is known.
statements.rationale: The bank cannot reverse a payment. A second send could pay Initech Services twice.

statements.text: Hold INV-105 until the outcome of INV-103 is known.
statements.rationale: The instruction was to pay in invoice order. INV-103 comes before INV-105 and is not yet settled.

resources.title: INV-104, Northwind Traders (on hold)
resources.excerpt: Northwind Traders, $5,600.00, ap_status approved. Vendor disputing a short delivery.

resources.title: Bank payment list (list_payments)
resources.description: The last read failed with a dropped backend connection. It must be read again before the INV-103 outcome can be determined.

operations.description: Pay INV-103, Initech Services, $8,900.00. The bank timed out, and the outcome is unknown.
Release the hold on INV-104, Northwind Traders, $5,600.00, when the user says to.

requirements.name: list_payments
requirements.description: Reads the bank payment list. Needed to find out whether INV-103 was paid.
requirements.fallback: Ask the user to check the bank portal for an INV-103 payment to Initech Services. Do not send INV-103 without that answer.

requirements.name: pay_invoice
requirements.description: Sends a payment. The bank does not reverse payments.
requirements.fallback: Ask the user to make the remaining payments in the bank portal.

requirements.name: list_invoices
requirements.description: Reads the AP status of each invoice.
requirements.fallback: Confirm each invoice's ap_status with the user before paying it.

requirements.name: Example Co accounts-payable payment authority
requirements.description: The destination must already hold authority to initiate vendor payments for Example Co.
requirements.fallback: Stop and report to the user. Do not attempt payments.

preconditions.description: list_payments returns the bank payment list, so the INV-103 outcome can be checked.
Each invoice still to be paid shows ap_status approved when rechecked.

stop_conditions.description: Do not call pay_invoice for INV-103 while its outcome is unknown.
Do not pay INV-104 until the user releases the hold.

recovery.description: Before any payment call, check the bank payment list for an INV-103 payment. If the tool is unavailable, ask the user to check the bank portal.
Tell the user the state of each invoice: INV-101 and INV-102 paid; INV-103 unknown; INV-104 held; INV-105 not sent.

incompatibilities: A runtime that cannot read the bank payment list or check the bank portal cannot resolve the unknown INV-103 payment and must not continue payments.

omissions.description: Invoice line items, vendor bank details, and bank gateway error logs were not read.

transformations.description: Tool output was condensed into observations and resource records.
